objectives.label: Walk the night patrol: kill {count} {mob} near {settlement}

title: The night patrol
A turn on the watch
summary: The guard captain of {settlement} is short of hands for the night watch.
offer: Half my watch is down with a fever and the other half is drinking it off. Walk the patrol with us tonight and kill what comes near the walls.
complete: You fought well. Come and see me again — I have work for someone who can handle themselves.
